$comment: Canary routing queries. Each entry pairs a colloquial user request with the fixture skill a well-routed agent should read first. 6 per skill (24 skills, 12 near-neighbor pairs), zh/en mixed. Per skill: 2 colloquial direct asks, 2 boundary-adjacent phrasings that flirt with the near neighbor, and 2 cross-cutting/exclusion-bait queries that name a neighboring domain while this skill stays primary. Difficulty is calibrated so the weak router lands off-ceiling (~85-95%) — do not copy wording from skill descriptions.
